added: packages/recovery-control: @sos-2/recovery-control — the rollback contract (spec/architecture.md section 13, docs/assurance-model.md 'Every live change declares: rollback mechanism, trigger, authority and evidence'): RecoveryDeclaration artifacts (documented, explicitly-registered spine extension kind 'RecoveryDeclaration' via the sanctioned add-only registerArtifactKind API — the W3/W5 precedent) with the exact content { change_ref, mechanism, trigger, authority_ref, evidence_ref, exception } — ALL FOUR declarations mandatory; typed bounded mechanisms (ROLLBACK_DEPLOYMENT/ DISABLE_FEATURE/ RESTORE_STATE/ CUSTOM_PROCEDURE — each with a concrete target) plus UNSPECIFIED as the unbounded case; typed concrete triggers (BUDGET metric+threshold+window, DEADLINE within_ms, MANUAL by a spine-identified authority — 'someone will notice' is rejected); GovernedException records (authority + alternative containment + provenance) as the ONLY acceptance path for unbounded recovery; deterministic content-addressed ids

packages/recovery-control policy: RecoveryPolicy artifacts (extension kind 'RecoveryPolicy', same registration precedent) with content { require_bounded_recovery } defaulting to TRUE (the section 13 rule); the ONLY mutation path is authority-gated — updateRecoveryPolicy requires origin TRUSTED_OPERATORS + authorize(grant, REVISE on THIS policy artifact) through the merged W1 authority (@sos-2/authority — never re-implemented), and WEAKENING (setting require_bounded_recovery to false) additionally requires an explicit governed exception record; candidate-originated changes are rejected UNCONDITIONALLY before any authority evaluation

packages/recovery-control gate: RecoveryGate.registerLiveChange performing the full four-step gate in order — declaration validity, policy check (unbounded/unspecified recovery REJECTED unless a governed exception exists), authority verification (the presented grant must BE the declaration's named authority_ref — no substitution — and validly authorize PROMOTE on the live change artifact at the registration instant through the merged W1 authority), and evidence verification (the referenced Evidence record must be present in the provided pool with availability SUCCESS — a failed/inconclusive rehearsal is not working evidence and a missing one is no evidence at all); duplicate declaration registration rejected; deterministic record ordering

packages/recovery-control/ARCHITECTURE-DELTA.json: this Architecture Delta record — DECLARED HERE because spec/** is outside W8's owned paths; the Architect may reconcile it into spec/contracts/deltas/ at merge time
preserved_invariants: TRUSTED BOUNDARY (spec/architecture-lock.md: the trusted assurance mechanism must not be disabled by untrusted candidate code): candidate-originated attempts to change the recovery policy are ALWAYS rejected — checked FIRST, unconditionally, before any authority evaluation, so no grant (however broad, stolen or over-delegated) can lift it; pinned by the dedicated test where a candidate disable attempt carrying a fully valid grant is still refused

authority integration is consumption, not duplication: all authorization flows through the merged W1 authority (authorize/evaluateGrant with their loud refusal paths — expired/revoked grants never authorize, scope violations and missing permissions refuse loudly); the gate verifies the declaration's OWN named grant (no substitution), and policy revision requires REVISE covering the policy artifact

bounded recovery is the rule (spec/architecture.md section 13): UNSPECIFIED mechanisms are rejected by the policy check unless an explicit governed exception record exists; weakening the global policy itself is an exceptional act requiring the same governed exception mechanism (the per-change escape is not a global off-switch)

fail-safe evidence verification: the referenced working-mechanism evidence must be provided and be SUCCESS — a declared containment that cannot be produced for verification is no containment; missing, failed and inconclusive rehearsals are all refused (distinct, never folded)

the Semantic Spine remains the ONLY identity/envelope authority: RecoveryDeclaration and RecoveryPolicy are registered through the sanctioned add-only registerArtifactKind API (no second kind registry, no mutation of frozen core kinds); ids are content-addressed over the exact creation address; envelopes come from createEnvelope

change-kind neutrality: change_ref references any consequential spine artifact (the change's own kind semantics — CandidateState, Decision, deployment — belong to their owning packages and are never redefined here); recovery-control never touches unmerged sibling work
determinism and reproducibility (R30): declaration/policy creation and gate registration are deterministic for identical inputs; canonical round trips preserve validity (property tests, fixed seed)
boundary_changes: new package boundary: packages/recovery-control depends on @sos-2/semantic-spine, @sos-2/authority and @sos-2/evidence (all merged at the W8 base) — consumption only, no modifications to any merged package

documented limitation (declared for Architect reconciliation): the governed exception's own authority_ref is structurally validated (well-formed spine id, non-null) but its grant is not re-evaluated at registration time — governance acts come in many kinds (Decision, AskRequest resolution, grant), so requiring a grant specifically would be too narrow; the declaration's primary authority IS fully verified
